sources.title: gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF: Video-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF is a quantized GGUF format version of Google DeepMind's Gemma 4 12B Unified model, maintained by unsloth. This is an instruction-tuned, multimodal model with 11.95B parameters that handles text, image, audio, and video inputs while generating text output.
